title: Preconditioned CG for cross-field solver to scale beyond 8K faces
description: PATCH-97 CG fallback shipped 24x speedup on small meshes (512 faces) but stalls on 8K+ face meshes because CG iterations per pin scale with sqrt(condition_number). Cross-field LSE matrix becomes ill-conditioned for large meshes. Standard remedy: preconditioned CG. Diagonal Jacobi preconditioner is cheap and often gets 3-10x iteration reduction. Block-diagonal or incomplete Cholesky preconditioners are more expensive but better. This unblocks PATCH-98 (cross-field recompute on rocker-arm).
definition-of-done: FaceRosyField + PATCH-97 CG completes on rocker-arm 20K faces in under 30 seconds. Singularity count converges to a stable value (currently times out before completing).
testing-plan: 1) Add Jacobi (diagonal) preconditioner to tryCG. 2) Run on subdividedSphere(5) (8192 faces) and rocker-arm. 3) If Jacobi insufficient, try block-diagonal or AMG. 4) Compare iteration counts and total time across mesh sizes.
